scope: 来世续缘 only (前尘忆梦 untouched)

features.corpse_direct_drop: All 附加.挖取 corpse-digging items drop directly on monster death (incl. empty 掉宝数据表 monsters); 附加.挖取 cleared to prevent double-loot; 镖车 excluded.
features.merc_ranged_any_enemy_blink: Ranged assassin mercenary skills (蝉舞/盛开/白莲/红莲/月桂) blink behind any adjacent enemy monster (Chebyshev dist <= 1), preferring tiles not adjacent to any enemy.
features.merc_ranged_skill_projectile: Ranged assassin mercenary skills still launch the spinning weapon projectile and defer both damage and skill hit animation (目标动画) to projectile arrival.
